title: Admin safety verifier rejects the canonical CPF transaction annotation
actual: FAIL: ADM change method transaction boundary is missing
rootCause: The verifier hard-codes Spring @Transactional(transactionManager = ...) syntax, while AdmOperatorService imports and uses the product-standard com.cpf.data.persistence.api.annotation.CpfTransactional on every mutation boundary.
repair: The gate requires the exact @CpfTransactional(transactionManager = admTransactionManager) contract with whitespace-tolerant syntax, and a regression statically forbids the former Spring expectation while executing the full gate.
verificationAttempt1: The static assertion passes, but the Python subprocess reader uses the Windows cp949 default against pwsh UTF-8 output and raises UnicodeDecodeError before reporting the actual gate result. This is a harness FAIL, not Product PASS/FAIL; the subprocess contract must explicitly decode UTF-8 with replacement for diagnostics.
repairPlan: Run the static/actual regression and continue the same broad gate to its next real result.
falseGreenForbidden: Do not add duplicate Spring annotations, weaken the requirement to any annotation, or suppress the verifier.
